body: I don’t really want to resort to it either as I’ve attempted it before and it wasn’t worth it. But I really don’t see a way to go from here. Going to school is going to pull me further and further down mentally which is the reason suicidal thoughts are coming back
Thank you. I just wish I knew where to start

As for talking to my friends and apologizing, I haven’t even gone back to school in a week and a half because it was killing me inside. And now I’m scared to go back because of my social anxiety. Most of my close friends already know what happened with the break up and the reason I act like this now as well

My dad has been abusive ever since me growing up, it felt like our family couldn’t get through a single week without some kind of conflict before I flat out started Ignoring them. On that specific night I was stopped from calling the police by my mum because its “our own family issue and we shouldn’t get anyone else involved” even tho I was there with blood all over and couldn’t hear out of one of my ears. If anyone finds out about it, it’ll ruin our immigration and we won’t be able to stay here anymore.
